fixed_vs_float.rationale: Taps rounded to Q15 (tap errors 0.0 (re), 2.4320568616811042e-4 (im)) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 6.138401566671432 Q15 LSB, x sqrt(2) for the complex magnitude. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: f32 rounding in an 65-tap sum: each of the n additions errs by at most 2^-24 of the partial sum (<= peak * sum|taps| = 2.492948747499832); twice that covers both evaluation orders (GNU Radio uses SIMD kernels): 0.8952 Q15 LSB.
